```{r libraries}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(reactable)
library(reactablefmtr) # masks gt::google_font and gt::html, so call those namespaced
```

Current NHL standings for the `r season_label` season. Data comes from the [fastRhockey](https://fastrhockey.sportsdataverse.org/) package from the SportsDataverse. For live scores and box scores, see [NHL Scores](https://steodose.github.io/nhl-scores/).

```{r data}
standings_raw <- nhl_standings()

# Date of the most recent completed game ("OFF" = final in the NHL schedule).
schedule <- load_nhl_schedule(nhl_season)
thru_date <- schedule %>%
  filter(game_type == "R", game_state %in% c("OFF", "FINAL")) %>%
  summarise(d = max(as.Date(game_date))) %>%
  pull(d)
thru_label <- format(thru_date, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish()

standings <- standings_raw %>%
  select(-team_logo) %>%  # NHL SVG; use the ESPN PNG from nhl_teams instead
  left_join(select(nhl_teams, team_abbr, team_logo), by = "team_abbr") %>%
  mutate(
    # Playoff position: top 3 in each division, then two wild cards per
    # conference. wildcard_sequence is 0 for the division top 3.
    pos = case_when(
      wildcard_sequence == 0 ~ paste0(division_abbrev, division_sequence),
      wildcard_sequence <= 2 ~ paste0("WC", wildcard_sequence),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    l10 = glue("{l10_wins}-{l10_losses}-{l10_ot_losses}"),
    streak = paste0(streak_code, streak_count)
  )
```

***
### Division Standings

```{r division-tables}
make_conference_table <- function(conf) {
  df <- standings %>%
    filter(conference_name == conf) %>%
    arrange(division_name, division_sequence) %>%
    transmute(division_name, team_logo, team_common_name, pos,
              games_played, wins, losses, ot_losses, points, point_pctg,
              regulation_wins, goals_for, goals_against, goal_differential,
              l10, streak)

  # Rows that end each division's top 3 get a dashed rule under them, the
  # line between automatic playoff spots and the wild-card race.
  cut_rows <- which(df$pos %in% c("A3", "M3", "C3", "P3"))
  wc_rows <- which(startsWith(df$pos, "WC"))

  df %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "division_name") %>%
    gt_img_rows(columns = team_logo, height = 25, img_source = "web") %>%
    gt_theme_538(quiet = TRUE) %>%
    opt_table_font(font = list(gt::google_font("Outfit"), default_fonts())) %>%
    cols_label(
      team_logo = "", team_common_name = "Team", pos = "",
      games_played = "GP", wins = "W", losses = "L", ot_losses = "OTL",
      points = "PTS", point_pctg = "P%", regulation_wins = "RW",
      goals_for = "GF", goals_against = "GA", goal_differential = "DIFF",
      l10 = "L10", streak = "STRK"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(point_pctg, decimals = 3, drop_trailing_zeros = FALSE) %>%
    fmt_number(goal_differential, decimals = 0, force_sign = TRUE) %>%
    data_color(columns = point_pctg, palette = my_color_pal) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#1a9850", weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_body(goal_differential, rows = goal_differential > 0)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#d73027", weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_body(goal_differential, rows = goal_differential < 0)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_body(points)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "grey50", size = px(12)),
              locations = cells_body(pos)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#2b7bb9", weight = "bold", size = px(12)),
              locations = cells_body(pos, rows = wc_rows)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "grey60",
                                   style = "dashed", weight = px(2)),
              locations = cells_body(rows = cut_rows)) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = -c(team_logo, team_common_name)) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(glue("**{conf} Conference**")),
               subtitle = glue("Thru games as of {thru_label}")) %>%
    tab_source_note(md("Dashed line = top 3 in division. **WC** = wild card. Data: fastRhockey"))
}

# Side by side on wide screens, stacked on narrow ones. gt_two_column_layout()
# uses floats that overflow the page column and pull the next heading up
# beside the tables, so this uses flexbox instead.
htmltools::div(
  style = "display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:24px; justify-content:center; align-items:flex-start;",
  htmltools::div(style = "flex:1 1 560px; min-width:0; overflow-x:auto;",
                 gt::as_raw_html(make_conference_table("Western"), inline_css = FALSE)),
  htmltools::div(style = "flex:1 1 560px; min-width:0; overflow-x:auto;",
                 gt::as_raw_html(make_conference_table("Eastern"), inline_css = FALSE))
)
```

***
### League Standings

Click a column header to sort. Teams are ranked by points percentage.

```{r league-table}
league_df <- standings %>%
  arrange(desc(point_pctg), desc(points), desc(regulation_wins)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    gf_gp = goals_for / games_played,
    ga_gp = goals_against / games_played
  ) %>%
  select(rank, team_logo, team_name, conference_name, division_name,
         games_played, wins, losses, ot_losses, points, point_pctg,
         gf_gp, ga_gp, goal_differential, l10, streak)

reactable(
  league_df,
  theme = theme_538,
  showSortIcon = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  language = reactableLang(searchPlaceholder = "SEARCH FOR A TEAM..."),
  pagination = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  fullWidth = FALSE,
  defaultColDef = colDef(align = "center", minWidth = 60),
  columns = list(
    rank = colDef(name = "Rank", maxWidth = 55),
    team_logo = colDef(name = "", maxWidth = 50, sortable = FALSE,
                       cell = embed_img(height = "25", width = "25")),
    team_name = colDef(name = "Team", align = "left", minWidth = 180),
    conference_name = colDef(name = "Conf", minWidth = 80),
    division_name = colDef(name = "Division", minWidth = 100),
    games_played = colDef(name = "GP"),
    wins = colDef(name = "W"),
    losses = colDef(name = "L"),
    ot_losses = colDef(name = "OTL"),
    points = colDef(name = "PTS", style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
    point_pctg = colDef(name = "P%", minWidth = 70,
                        format = colFormat(digits = 3),
                        style = color_scales(league_df, colors = my_color_pal)),
    gf_gp = colDef(name = "GF/GP", minWidth = 70, format = colFormat(digits = 2)),
    ga_gp = colDef(name = "GA/GP", minWidth = 70, format = colFormat(digits = 2)),
    goal_differential = colDef(
      name = "DIFF",
      style = function(value) list(
        color = if (value > 0) "#1a9850" else if (value < 0) "#d73027" else "#333",
        fontWeight = "bold"
      )
    ),
    l10 = colDef(name = "L10", sortable = FALSE, minWidth = 70),
    streak = colDef(name = "STRK", sortable = FALSE)
  )
)
```
